column1: <Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Confirmation</subject>Have you heard back from the NFL yet? Have I really been named MVP?
column2: <Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>확인 부탁</subject>NFL에서 아직 연락 없었나요? 제가 정말 MVP로 뽑혔나요?

column1:
<Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Horse Trailer</subject>

One of my friends just called me and told me I was named the Horse Trailer player of the game.

John and Al must really like me.

I didn't think I had that great of a game.
column2:
<Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>호스 트레일러</subject>

방금 친구한테 전화가 왔는데, 제가 오늘 경기의 호스 트레일러 선수로 뽑혔대요.

존하고 알이 저를 정말 좋아하나 봐요.

그렇게 잘한 경기라고는 생각 안 했는데요.

column1: <Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Player of the Week</subject>\r\n\r\nMy agent told me that I was named the player of the week.
column2: <Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>이 주의 선수</subject>\r\n\r\n에이전트가 그러는데 제가 이 주의 선수로 뽑혔대요.

column1:
<Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Player of the Week</subject>

Was I really named the player of the week?

That's awesome.
column2:
<Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>이 주의 선수</subject>

제가 정말 이 주의 선수로 뽑혔나요?

정말 최고예요.

column1:
<Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1%</from><subject>My award</subject>

Well, my agent told me the news this morning.

I've been named to the All-Pro team.

Thanks for all of your help.
column2:
<Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1%</from><subject>제 상</subject>

오늘 아침에 에이전트한테 소식을 들었어요.

제가 올프로 팀에 뽑혔대요.

그동안 도와주셔서 감사합니다.

column1:
<Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1%</from><subject>Player of the Year</subject>

It's quite an honor to be named the player of the year.

Thank you for all of your support and help.
column2:
<Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1%</from><subject>올해의 선수</subject>

올해의 선수로 뽑히다니 정말 영광이에요.

그동안 응원해 주시고 도와주셔서 감사합니다.

column1:
<Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1%</from><subject>Yeah!</subject>

My agent told me I've been recognized as the player of the year at my position.

I'm grateful for all you've done for me.
column2:
<Award Announced><from>%plyr_first_name-1%</from><subject>좋았어!</subject>

에이전트가 그러는데 제가 제 포지션에서 올해의 선수로 뽑혔대요.

저를 위해 해 주신 모든 일에 감사드려요.

column1:
<Award Announced><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>All-Pro</subject>

Just like we expected, %plyr_last_name-1% won it. 

Maybe now he'll get the respect he deserves as the best runner in the league. 

We should call a press conference for 11:00am tomorrow morning and maybe throw a party tomorrow night. What do you say?
column2:
<Award Announced><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>올프로</subject>

예상대로 %plyr_last_name-1% 선수가 상을 탔습니다. 

이제야 리그 최고의 러너로서 제대로 인정받겠군요. 

내일 오전 11시에 기자회견을 열고, 내일 밤에는 파티라도 하는 게 어떨까요?

column1: <Award Announced><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Thanks</subject>I don't know if you heard, but I just won the coach of the year award. I owe it all to you. If you hadn't given me the chance, I wouldn't be here today.\r\n\r\nThanks again!
column2: <Award Announced><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>감사합니다</subject>들으셨는지 모르겠지만, 제가 올해의 감독상을 받았습니다. 모두 구단주님 덕분입니다. 기회를 주지 않으셨다면 지금의 저는 없었을 거예요.\r\n\r\n다시 한번 감사드립니다!

column1:
<Award Announced><from>GM</from><subject>MVP</subject>

I just got off the phone with the league.

The MVP award will be announced tomorrow morning.

The winner?

Our very own %plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%.
column2:
<Award Announced><from>GM</from><subject>MVP</subject>

방금 리그와 통화를 마쳤습니다.

MVP는 내일 아침에 발표된답니다.

수상자는요?

바로 우리 팀의 %plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1% 선수입니다.

column1:
<Award Announced><from>GM</from><subject>News</subject>

I just heard on EA Sports Radio that the NFL has announced that %plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1% has been named the player of the year.

Pretty cool, huh?
column2:
<Award Announced><from>GM</from><subject>소식</subject>

EA SPORTS 라디오에서 들었는데, NFL에서 %plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1% 선수를 올해의 선수로 발표했대요.

멋지지 않나요?

column1: <Award Announced><from>GM</from><subject>Tony Bruno</subject>\r\n\r\nI just heard Tony Bruno say that %plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1% is the player of the week.
column2: <Award Announced><from>GM</from><subject>토니 브루노</subject>\r\n\r\n방금 토니 브루노가 %plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1% 선수가 이 주의 선수라고 하더군요.

column1:
<Award Announced><from>General Manager</from><subject>Player of the Year</subject>

%plyr_last_name-1% was just named the Defensive Player of the Year by USA Today. 

I'm so happy for him.

He definitely deserves it for the season he had.
column2:
<Award Announced><from>단장</from><subject>올해의 선수</subject>

%plyr_last_name-1% 선수가 USA 투데이 선정 올해의 수비 선수로 뽑혔습니다. 

정말 기쁘네요.

올 시즌 활약을 생각하면 받을 자격이 충분합니다.

column1:
<Award Announced><from>General Manager</from><subject>Player of the Year</subject>

I don't know if you saw it on TV, but %plyr_last_name-1% was just named the Offensive Player of the Year by USA Today. 

That's great and all but this is only going to hurt us financially in the long run. 

I'm sure he'll parlay this into a contract demand in the near future.
column2:
<Award Announced><from>단장</from><subject>올해의 선수</subject>

TV로 보셨는지 모르겠지만, %plyr_last_name-1% 선수가 USA 투데이 선정 올해의 공격 선수로 뽑혔습니다. 

좋은 일이긴 한데, 길게 보면 재정적으로는 손해일 겁니다. 

분명 조만간 이걸 내세워 계약 요구를 해 올 거예요.

column1: <Award Announced><from>John Madden</from><subject>Congratulations!</subject>I just wanted to drop %plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1% a line to congratulate him on being the horse trailer player of the game Monday night.

column1: <Award Announced><from>Scouting Dir.</from><subject>Rookie of the Year</subject>He's a heck of a kid, isn't he? Rookie of the Year. Who knew when we were scouting this kid that he would end up being the rookie of the year.
column2: <Award Announced><from>스카우트 담당</from><subject>올해의 신인</subject>정말 대단한 친구죠? 올해의 신인이라니. 이 친구를 스카우트할 때만 해도 올해의 신인이 될 줄 누가 알았겠어요.

column1:
<Award Announced><from>Tony Bruno</from><subject>MVP</subject>

You're lucky to have a player of %plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%'s caliber.

He had a beau-tiful year this year and he deserved the MVP.
column2:
<Award Announced><from>토니 브루노</from><subject>MVP</subject>

%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1% 같은 수준의 선수가 있다니 운이 좋으시네요.

올해 정말 아-름다운 한 해를 보냈고, MVP를 받을 만했어요.

column1:
<Award Announced><from>Tony Bruno</from><subject>Monday Night</subject>

I was watching the game on Monday night and I noticed that %plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1% was honored as the Horse Trailer Player of the Game.

Can you pass on my congratulations to him?
column2:
<Award Announced><from>토니 브루노</from><subject>월요일 밤</subject>

월요일 밤 경기를 보다가 %plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1% 선수가 호스 트레일러 경기 최우수 선수로 뽑힌 걸 봤어요.

제 축하 인사 좀 전해 주시겠어요?

We're a little concerned about the losses incurred by your franchise.

Is there anything we can do to help?

귀 구단의 손실에 대해 다소 우려하고 있습니다.

저희가 도와드릴 일이 있을까요?

column1:
<Coach Milestone><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Wow</subject>

What a horrible season.

I should be let go for my terrible coaching job this season.
column2:
<Coach Milestone><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>이런</subject>

정말 끔찍한 시즌이었습니다.

올 시즌 지도를 이렇게 형편없이 했으니 해고당해도 할 말이 없습니다.

column1:
<Coach Milestone><from>GM</from><subject>Respect</subject>

I hope Coach %coach_name-c% gets the respect he deserves now that he won his first Super Bowl.

He has certainly earned it.
column2:
<Coach Milestone><from>GM</from><subject>존경</subject>

%coach_name-c% 감독이 첫 슈퍼볼 우승을 했으니 이제 마땅한 존경을 받았으면 좋겠네요.

충분히 그럴 자격이 있어요.

column1:
<Coach Milestone><from>Personal Asst.</from><subject>Party Time</subject>

I just wanted to ok the party with you. 

It'll only cost a couple hundred thousand but for an old moneybags like you, that's just a drop in the bucket, huh? 

BTW...I sent a card to %coach_name-c% congratulating him. 

You might want to give him a call.
column2:
<Coach Milestone><from>개인 비서</from><subject>파티 시간</subject>

파티 건으로 허락을 받으려고요. 

몇십만 달러밖에 안 드는데, 구단주님 같은 부자한테는 새 발의 피죠? 

그리고... %coach_name-c% 감독에게 축하 카드를 보냈어요. 

전화 한 통 해 주시는 것도 좋겠어요.

column1: <Coach Strategy Change><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>3-4?</subject>We sat down as a coaching staff and decided to switch to the 3-4 on defense. It's going to be a bit weird at first, but I really believe that we have the personnel to be successful in this defense. This will hide a lot of the holes we have, too.
column2: <Coach Strategy Change><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>3-4?</subject>코칭 스태프 회의 끝에 수비를 3-4로 바꾸기로 했습니다. 처음엔 좀 어색하겠지만, 이 수비로 성공할 만한 선수들이 있다고 확신합니다. 우리 팀의 약점도 많이 가려 줄 겁니다.

column1: <Coach Strategy Change><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>4-3</subject>We sat down as a coaching staff and decided to switch to the 4-3 on defense. It's going to be a bit weird at first, but I really believe that we have the personnel to be successful in a base defense. We were getting stretched a bit too thin in the 3-4. Let me know if there is a problem.
column2: <Coach Strategy Change><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>4-3</subject>코칭 스태프 회의 끝에 수비를 4-3으로 바꾸기로 했습니다. 처음엔 좀 어색하겠지만, 기본 수비로 성공할 만한 선수들이 있다고 확신합니다. 3-4에서는 선수들이 너무 무리하고 있었어요. 문제가 있으면 알려 주세요.

column1: <Coach Strategy Change><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Pass D</subject>You have my word. We will focus on stopping the pass from now on.
column2: <Coach Strategy Change><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>패스 수비</subject>약속드립니다. 앞으로는 패스를 막는 데 집중하겠습니다.

column1: <Coach Strategy Change><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Passing the ball</subject>I got your message. I know the media has been blowing it out of proportion, but I live by a basic philosophy: Run the ball and stop the run. We'll open it up more, but I don't like it. I don't care what the fans want to see.
column2: <Coach Strategy Change><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>패스 공격</subject>메시지 받았습니다. 언론이 너무 부풀리고 있는 건 알지만, 제 기본 철학은 '달리고, 달리기를 막아라'입니다. 패스를 더 늘리긴 하겠지만 마음에 들진 않네요. 팬들이 뭘 보고 싶어 하든 상관없습니다.

column1: <Coach Strategy Change><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Re: Mistakes</subject>I can't just change the way I coach. I agree we're taking too many risks, but I'm not sure dumbing things down is the answer. You sign the checks, though.
column2: <Coach Strategy Change><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>Re: 실수</subject>제 지도 방식을 그냥 바꿀 수는 없습니다. 위험을 너무 많이 감수한다는 건 동의하지만, 단순하게 가는 게 답인지는 모르겠네요. 그래도 월급 주시는 분은 구단주님이니까요.

column1: <Coach Strategy Change><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Re: Sleepwalking</subject>I know you think we are too boring, so I've decided to open it up a bit and be more aggressive. Whatever you want.
column2: <Coach Strategy Change><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>Re: 지루한 경기</subject>우리 경기가 너무 지루하다고 생각하시는 것 같아서, 좀 더 공격적으로 풀어 가기로 했습니다. 원하시는 대로 하죠.

column1: <Coach Strategy Change><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Run D</subject>You have my word. We will focus on stopping the run from now on.
column2: <Coach Strategy Change><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>런 수비</subject>약속드립니다. 앞으로는 런을 막는 데 집중하겠습니다.

column1: <Coach Strategy Change><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Run game</subject>I got your message. I know the media has been blowing it out of proportion, but I live by a basic philosophy: Run the ball and stop the run. We WILL be committing to the run more from now on.
column2: <Coach Strategy Change><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>러닝 게임</subject>메시지 받았습니다. 언론이 너무 부풀리고 있는 건 알지만, 제 기본 철학은 '달리고, 달리기를 막아라'입니다. 앞으로는 반드시 런 플레이에 더 힘을 쏟겠습니다.

column1:
<Last Week Game><from>GM</from><subject>Yeah!</subject>

What a comeback.

I thought we were out of that game going into the fourth quarter.
column2:
<Last Week Game><from>GM</from><subject>좋았어!</subject>

대단한 역전승이에요.

4쿼터 들어갈 때는 끝난 줄 알았어요.

column1:
<Last Week Game><from>Marketing</from><subject>TV Ratings</subject>

Last week's game has the highest ratings of any game on TV because it was so close.

Our stadium advertisers were quite pleased.
column2:
<Last Week Game><from>마케팅팀</from><subject>TV 시청률</subject>

지난주 경기는 접전이었던 덕분에 TV 중계 경기 중 시청률이 가장 높았습니다.

경기장 광고주들도 아주 만족했어요.

column1:
<Last Week Game><from>PR Dept.</from><subject>Aftermath</subject>

The best thing that can happen to an NFL franchise is to win the Super Bowl!

What a magical season. Now we can release one of those season in review videos like every Super Bowl winner does.

We've got T-shirts, mugs, doormats, you name it.
column2:
<Last Week Game><from>홍보팀</from><subject>그 후</subject>

NFL 구단에 일어날 수 있는 최고의 일은 슈퍼볼 우승이죠!

정말 꿈 같은 시즌이었어요. 이제 다른 슈퍼볼 우승 팀들처럼 시즌 결산 영상도 낼 수 있어요.

티셔츠, 머그컵, 현관 매트까지 없는 게 없어요.

column1:
<Last Week Game><from>PR Dept.</from><subject>Win</subject>

The TV ratings for last week's win were absymal.

I chalk a lot of that up to the %team_mascot_name-1%.
column2:
<Last Week Game><from>홍보팀</from><subject>승리</subject>

지난주 승리 경기의 TV 시청률은 최악이었습니다.

그건 %team_mascot_name-1% 팀 탓이 크다고 봐요.

column1:
<Last Week Game><from>Team President</from><subject>Yeah!</subject>

That was a pretty good win.

It's always nice to beat a team that is as talented as the %team_mascot_name-1% are.
column2:
<Last Week Game><from>구단 사장</from><subject>좋았어!</subject>

꽤 괜찮은 승리였어요.

%team_mascot_name-1% 팀처럼 재능 있는 팀을 이기는 건 언제나 기분 좋죠.

column1:
<Morale Concequences><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Holdout</subject>

I asked you to trade me and you didn't.

That's fine. I'll just sit at home and collect paychecks until you get rid of me.
column2:
<Morale Concequences><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>훈련 거부</subject>

트레이드해 달라고 했는데 안 해 주셨죠.

좋아요. 저를 내보낼 때까지 집에 앉아서 월급만 받을게요.

column1:
<Morale Concequences><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Not re-signing</subject>

Don't bother trying to re-sign my client in a few weeks.

He will not be playing for your team at any point in the future.
column2:
<Morale Concequences><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>재계약 안 함</subject>

몇 주 뒤에 제 고객과 재계약하려고 애쓰지 마세요.

앞으로 절대 그쪽 팀에서 뛰지 않을 겁니다.

column1:
<Morale Concequences><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Trade me</subject>

I told you some nasty stuff would happen once we got to the offseason.

Trade me now. If I'm still on the team at the end of the offseason, I'll hold out until I'm off this team.
column2:
<Morale Concequences><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>트레이드</subject>

오프시즌이 되면 안 좋은 일이 생길 거라고 말씀드렸죠.

지금 저를 트레이드하세요. 오프시즌이 끝날 때까지 팀에 남아 있으면, 팀을 떠날 때까지 훈련을 거부할 거예요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%
</from><subject>Our "O"</subject>

Man, we have a great offense.

Did you know we finished in the top 5 in the league this year?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%
</from><subject>우리 공격</subject>

와, 우리 공격 정말 대단해요.

올해 리그 공격 순위 5위 안에 든 거 아세요?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%
</from><subject>Wins Championships</subject>

Our defense is dominant.

It's pretty sweet that we can brag to other players around the league about it.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%
</from><subject>수비가 우승을 만든다</subject>

우리 수비는 압도적이에요.

리그의 다른 선수들한테 자랑할 수 있어서 정말 좋아요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>All-Pro</subject>

Pretty sweet, huh?

It's always nice to be recognized as the best player in the league at your position.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>올프로</subject>

꽤 멋지죠?

제 포지션에서 리그 최고로 인정받는 건 언제나 기분 좋아요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Award</subject>

I was watching TV last night when I heard that I'd won Offensive Player of the Year.

I owe it all to Coach %coach_name-c% and my teammates.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>수상</subject>

어젯밤에 TV를 보다가 제가 올해의 공격 선수상을 받았다는 소식을 들었어요.

모두 %coach_name-c% 감독님과 동료들 덕분이에요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Award</subject>

Rookie of the Year.

And everybody at the combine said I was overrated.

Rate me now.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>수상</subject>

올해의 신인.

컴바인 때는 다들 제가 과대평가됐다고 했죠.

이제 다시 평가해 보시죠.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Award</subject>

The NFL just named me the defensive player of the year.

I think this is the happiest day of my life.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>수상</subject>

NFL에서 저를 올해의 수비 선수로 뽑았어요.

제 인생에서 가장 행복한 날인 것 같아요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>MVP</subject>

I couldn't be happier after winning the MVP.

Pretty cool, huh?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>MVP</subject>

MVP를 받아서 더할 나위 없이 행복해요.

멋지죠?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

All I can think about is not making the playoffs. 

How could we do all of that work for nothing?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

플레이오프에 못 간 생각밖에 안 나요. 

그렇게 고생했는데 다 소용없다니요?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Another questionable trade from you guys.

Are you trying to run the team into the ground?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

또 이해할 수 없는 트레이드를 하셨네요.

팀을 망치려고 작정하신 건가요?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Can you explain to me how releasing one of our players who won an award this year helps the team?

Well?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

올해 상을 받은 선수를 방출하는 게 팀에 어떻게 도움이 되는지 설명 좀 해 주실래요?

네?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

I don't know who made the call, but I won that starting job in a position battle.

All of a sudden, it's taken away from me.

How do you think that makes me feel?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

누가 결정했는지는 모르겠지만, 저는 주전 경쟁에서 이겨서 그 자리를 따냈어요.

그런데 갑자기 그걸 빼앗겼네요.

제 기분이 어떨 것 같으세요?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

I was happy to see us re-sign one of our Icons.

That really made an impression on me.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

우리 팀 간판 선수와 재계약해서 기뻤어요.

정말 인상 깊었어요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

It feels good to make the playoffs.

That'll boost anybody's morale.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

플레이오프에 진출하니 기분 좋네요.

누구라도 사기가 오를 거예요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

It really stinks that we have such a terrible defense.

Are we going to address that in the offseason?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

우리 수비가 이렇게 형편없다니 정말 답답해요.

오프시즌에 보강할 건가요?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Losing to our rival frustrates me.

I hate this feeling.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

라이벌에게 지니까 정말 속상해요.

이런 기분 정말 싫어요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Our offense is a joke.

Are we going to fix it in the offseason?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

우리 공격은 형편없어요.

오프시즌에 고칠 건가요?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Rival?

Please. I love beating those guys.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

라이벌이요?

무슨 소리예요. 저는 그 팀 이기는 게 정말 좋아요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Slapping me with the franchise tag is not a great idea.

I thought we had a good professional relationship.

Don't try to cheat me out of money I deserve.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

저한테 프랜차이즈 태그를 붙이는 건 좋은 생각이 아니에요.

우리가 좋은 관계라고 생각했는데요.

제가 받아야 할 돈을 떼먹으려 하지 마세요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Sweet.

We won the division and we're in the playoffs.

That really puts a smile on my face.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

좋았어.

디비전 우승에 플레이오프 진출이에요.

정말 웃음이 절로 나네요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

That latest trade was a disaster.

Why are we making moves like this?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

이번 트레이드는 재앙이었어요.

왜 이런 결정을 하는 거죠?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

The Coach %coach_name-c% hiring really has me shaking my head.

That's the last guy we needed as our head coach.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

%coach_name-c% 감독을 데려왔다니 정말 어이가 없네요.

우리 감독으로는 제일 안 맞는 사람이에요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Those guys talked all week but they couldn't back it up on the field.

That win really improved my morale.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

그 팀은 일주일 내내 큰소리치더니 경기장에서는 아무것도 못 보여 줬죠.

그 승리로 사기가 정말 올랐어요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

We should have never lost that game.

I just can't stop thinking about it.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

그 경기는 절대 지면 안 됐어요.

자꾸 그 생각만 나요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Why did we promote Coach %coach_name-c%?

That guy doesn't deserve to be a head coach.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

왜 %coach_name-c% 코치를 감독으로 승격시킨 거죠?

그 사람은 감독 자격이 없어요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Why would you trade a player who just won such a big award?

That's a pretty cold move.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

그렇게 큰 상을 받은 선수를 왜 트레이드하시는 거죠?

정말 차가운 결정이네요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Winning the Super Bowl made my season.

All of a sudden I'm much happier.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>사기</subject>

슈퍼볼 우승으로 제 시즌이 완성됐어요.

갑자기 훨씬 행복해졌어요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Not good</subject>

What is the reasoning behind releasing our great players?

The guy you just cut was my friend.

How does that help us?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>안 좋아요</subject>

우리 팀의 훌륭한 선수들을 방출하는 이유가 뭐죠?

방금 내보낸 선수는 제 친구였어요.

그게 무슨 도움이 되나요?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Question</subject>

Bringing in an Icon does a lot for my morale.

It's good to see that you guys are trying to improve the team.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>질문</subject>

간판 선수를 데려오니 사기가 많이 올라요.

팀을 강하게 만들려고 노력하시는 모습이 보기 좋아요.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Question</subject>

Do you like losing top tier players?

How is this team ever going to improve?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>질문</subject>

최상급 선수들을 잃는 게 좋으세요?

이래서 팀이 언제 나아지겠어요?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Question</subject>

Great idea to not re-sign one of our Icons.

That'll certainly help things around here, I'm sure.

What were you thinking?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>질문</subject>

간판 선수와 재계약을 안 하다니 참 좋은 생각이네요.

분명 팀에 큰 도움이 되겠죠.

대체 무슨 생각이셨어요?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Question</subject>

I'm happy about that trade.

Icons are great to have on the team.
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>질문</subject>

그 트레이드는 마음에 들어요.

간판 선수가 팀에 있으면 정말 좋죠.

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Question</subject>

What would ever convince you to release an Icon?

Was it personal with you?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>질문</subject>

대체 무슨 이유로 간판 선수를 방출하신 거죠?

개인적인 감정이었나요?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Question</subject>

Why are we cutting team captains?

Was that just a whim or a calculated move?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>질문</subject>

왜 팀 주장들을 방출하는 거죠?

그냥 기분대로 한 건가요, 계산된 결정인가요?

column1:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>Question</subject>

Why would we not re-sign a player who just won an award?

Was it money?
column2:
<Morale><from>%plyr_first_name-1% %plyr_last_name-1%</from><subject>질문</subject>

기회를 주셔서 감사하지만, 다시 맞붙을 날이 기다려지네요.

기세를 몰아 플레이오프로 갑시다.

These things look horrible.
column2:
<Uniform Edited><from>홍보팀</from><subject>유니폼</subject>

이 유니폼 변경을 누가 승인했나요?

정말 끔찍해 보여요.

column1:
<Week><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Gameplan</subject>

Every week, you'll see a breakdown of the upcoming opponent and a gameplan put together by me in preparation for the game. 

If we follow this gameplan every week, we should be able to compete in every game.
column2:
<Week><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>작전</subject>

매주 다음 상대 분석과 제가 준비한 작전을 보시게 될 겁니다.

매주 이 작전대로만 하면 모든 경기에서 해볼 만할 겁니다.

column1:
<Week><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Pos. Battles</subject>

Let me give you the rundown on position battles. 

Every preseason, I'll have guys battle it out for certain starting jobs. 

Based on their preseason performance, I will name the starter. 

Be careful with the players. If I name one guy a starter and you demand I bench him, he will get very upset.
column2:
<Week><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>주전 경쟁</subject>

주전 경쟁에 대해 설명드리겠습니다.

매년 프리시즌마다 일부 주전 자리를 두고 선수들끼리 경쟁하게 합니다.

프리시즌 성적을 보고 주전을 정하겠습니다.

선수들을 조심히 다뤄 주세요. 제가 주전으로 정한 선수를 벤치에 앉히라고 하시면 그 선수가 크게 상처받을 겁니다.

column1:
<Week><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Super Bowl Week</subject>

This is such a great week in sports.

All of the hype, interviews and media coverage makes this almost a national holiday.
column2:
<Week><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>슈퍼볼 주간</subject>

스포츠계에서 정말 멋진 한 주입니다.

온갖 열기와 인터뷰, 언론 보도로 거의 국경일 같죠.

column1:
<Week><from>Coach %coach_name-c%</from><subject>Team Captains</subject>

If you want input on who our team captains are going to be, just go to their player management screen in rosters and name the individual guys team captains.

The three players you name will be at the coin toss for every game.
column2:
<Week><from>%coach_name-c% 감독</from><subject>팀 주장</subject>

팀 주장 선정에 의견을 내고 싶으시면 로스터의 선수 관리 화면에서 원하는 선수를 팀 주장으로 지명하세요.

지명한 세 선수가 매 경기 동전 던지기에 나갑니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>Championship Game</subject>

Whoever wins these games makes it to the Super Bowl.

This is the most exciting week in the playoffs, in my opinion.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>챔피언십 경기</subject>

이번 경기 승자가 슈퍼볼에 진출합니다.

제 생각엔 플레이오프에서 가장 흥미진진한 주입니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>Draft pick signing</subject>

Now that the draft is over, let's get these kids signed to deals.

Sign the players using the following rules:

1. First round picks - sign them to long deals since they want tons of money.

2. 2nd - 5th round picks - sign these guys to 3-year deals.

The reason is so that if they become stars, they also become restricted free agents in 3 years.

That means we can get draft picks for them.

3. 6th - 7th rounders - sign them to 1-year deals.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>신인 계약</subject>

드래프트가 끝났으니 신인들과 계약합시다.

다음 원칙에 따라 계약하세요.

1. 1라운드 지명자 - 큰돈을 원하니 장기 계약을 하세요.

2. 2-5라운드 지명자 - 3년 계약을 하세요.

스타가 되더라도 3년 뒤엔 제한적 FA가 되기 때문입니다.

그러면 그 대가로 드래프트 지명권을 받을 수 있습니다.

3. 6-7라운드 지명자 - 1년 계약을 하세요.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>EA Sports Radio</subject>

I don't know if you've heard of this Tony Bruno guy, but he's the highest rated sports radio host out there and his show on EA Sports Radio is hilarious! 

Check it out if you get time.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>EA SPORTS 라디오</subject>

토니 브루노라고 들어 보셨는지 모르겠는데, 최고 인기 스포츠 라디오 진행자예요. EA SPORTS 라디오의 그 쇼는 정말 웃깁니다!

시간 나면 한번 들어 보세요.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>Franchise Tags</subject>

It's inevitable that some players will refuse to re-sign with us in the offseason.

One of the best ways to keep those players around is to place the franchise tag on them. 

It won't make them happy, but it will keep them around one more year.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>프랜차이즈 태그</subject>

오프시즌에 재계약을 거부하는 선수는 반드시 나옵니다.

그런 선수를 붙잡는 가장 좋은 방법 중 하나가 프랜차이즈 태그를 거는 겁니다.

선수는 좋아하지 않겠지만, 1년은 더 붙잡아 둘 수 있습니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>Free Agency</subject>

Free Agency is the time of the offseason where we can improve our roster the most.

We need to get out there and add some valuable pieces for our run next year.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>FA 시장</subject>

FA 시장은 오프시즌 중 로스터를 가장 크게 보강할 수 있는 시기입니다.

내년을 위해 적극적으로 쓸 만한 선수들을 영입해야 합니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>Morale</subject>

Players in the NFL are very touchy. Being an NFL owner means you have to oversee the team and your players. 

Players have a certain confidence or morale and everything that happens to them affects it. 

It's your job to make sure that the players are comfortable and want to play here. If they're not, look out. You'll see what I mean.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>사기</subject>

NFL 선수들은 아주 예민합니다. NFL 구단주라면 팀과 선수들을 잘 관리해야 합니다.

선수마다 자신감이나 사기가 있고, 그들에게 일어나는 모든 일이 여기에 영향을 줍니다.

선수들이 편하게 여기서 뛰고 싶어 하도록 만드는 게 구단주님의 일입니다. 그렇지 않으면 조심하세요. 무슨 말인지 아시게 될 겁니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>NFL Draft</subject>

Are you going to the draft this year?

Let me know if you are.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>NFL 드래프트</subject>

올해 드래프트에 가실 건가요?

가시면 알려 주세요.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>New Season</subject>

It's a new season.

Everybody's a contender in August.

Let's have a great season.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>새 시즌</subject>

새 시즌입니다.

8월엔 누구나 우승 후보죠.

멋진 시즌을 만들어 봅시다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>Offseason Schedule</subject>

Now that the business stuff is behind us, we need to start looking at the players.

Player retirements generally happen right now, so pay attention to those.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>오프시즌 일정</subject>

사업 관련 일은 끝났으니 이제 선수들을 살펴봐야 합니다.

선수 은퇴는 보통 이 시기에 있으니 잘 지켜보세요.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>Playoffs</subject>

The winners of these four games move on to the final test before the Super Bowl.

Big playoff week.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>플레이오프</subject>

이 네 경기의 승자가 슈퍼볼 전 마지막 관문에 오릅니다.

중요한 플레이오프 주간입니다.

column1: <Week><from>GM</from><subject>Practice</subject>\r\n\r\nMake sure you go to practice every week. It'll help familiarize you with the team and the opposing team's playbook.
column2: <Week><from>단장</from><subject>연습</subject>\r\n\r\n매주 꼭 연습에 참가하세요. 우리 팀과 상대 팀의 플레이북을 익히는 데 도움이 됩니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>Preseason</subject>

The preseason kicks off and there are a few things we need to keep an eye on.

1. Position battles - Remember, player stats in preseason will determine the winners of position battles.

2. Injuries - Keep our best players out of the games. If they get hurt, our season could be ruined.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>프리시즌</subject>

프리시즌이 시작됐으니 눈여겨볼 게 몇 가지 있습니다.

1. 주전 경쟁 - 프리시즌 기록으로 주전 경쟁의 승자가 정해진다는 걸 기억하세요.

2. 부상 - 주축 선수들은 경기에 내보내지 마세요. 다치면 시즌을 망칠 수 있습니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>RFA</subject>

I don't know if you've dealt with restricted free agents prior to this, but just remember a couple of things. 

When making an offer to another team's player, the more you offer the player in terms of contract, the better the compensation the other team gets. 

If you pay him too much, the other guys will get our first round pick. 

Not advisable unless it's Mike Vick.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>제한적 FA</subject>

제한적 FA를 다뤄 보셨는지 모르겠지만, 몇 가지만 기억해 주세요.

다른 팀 선수에게 제안할 때는 계약 조건이 클수록 상대 팀이 받는 보상도 커집니다.

너무 많이 주면 상대 팀이 우리 1라운드 지명권을 가져갑니다.

마이크 빅 정도가 아니라면 권하지 않습니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>RFA</subject>

Now we have to re-sign our players who are no longer under contract.

Spend wisely and make sure you keep an eye on the other free agents that will be available.

Be ready - the elite guys are going to ask for tons of money.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>제한적 FA</subject>

이제 계약이 끝난 선수들과 재계약해야 합니다.

돈을 현명하게 쓰시고, 시장에 나올 다른 FA 선수들도 잘 살펴보세요.

각오하세요 - 최정상급 선수들은 엄청난 돈을 요구할 겁니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>The Combine</subject>

The combine starts this week.

This is where we get our first look at the players who will be our stars in the future.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>컴바인</subject>

이번 주에 컴바인이 시작됩니다.

미래의 스타가 될 선수들을 처음 볼 수 있는 자리입니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>The Draft</subject>

During the yearly NFL draft, teams furiously work the phones to trade up or down in the draft to get their man. 

We could be offered a trade at any time. 

Keep an eye on the players that are left on the board, because a team could trade up and grab any player that we want.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>드래프트</subject>

매년 NFL 드래프트 때면 각 팀은 원하는 선수를 잡으려고 지명 순위를 올리거나 내리는 트레이드를 하느라 전화통에 불이 납니다.

언제든 트레이드 제안이 올 수 있습니다.

남은 선수들을 잘 지켜보세요. 다른 팀이 순위를 올려 우리가 원하는 선수를 가로챌 수도 있습니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>Training Camp</subject>

It's the start of a new season.

With all of the new faces we have, we need to make sure that we evaluate every player in training camp and preseason.

If I were you, I'd call a couple of practices to get comfortable with the new rookies and free agents.
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>트레이닝 캠프</subject>

새 시즌의 시작입니다.

새 얼굴이 많으니 트레이닝 캠프와 프리시즌에서 모든 선수를 꼼꼼히 평가해야 합니다.

제가 구단주님이라면 연습을 몇 번 소집해서 새 신인과 FA 선수들을 익히겠습니다.

column1:
<Week><from>GM</from><subject>WC</subject>

The playoffs start this week.

This is the most exciting time of the year!
column2:
<Week><from>단장</from><subject>와일드카드</subject>

이번 주에 플레이오프가 시작됩니다.

1년 중 가장 흥미진진한 때죠!

column1:
<Week><from>Head Scout</from><subject>Scouting</subject>

Every couple of weeks, we'll sit down and prepare a progress report for each player. 

Based on their recent performance, I'll reassess each player's attributes and regrade them. 

We'll do this in weeks 5, 11, 17 of the regular season and also in the playoffs. 

After the season, a scout will prepare a report on each player's physical progress.
column2:
<Week><from>수석 스카우트</from><subject>스카우트 팀</subject>

몇 주마다 선수별 성장 보고서를 준비하겠습니다.

최근 활약을 바탕으로 각 선수의 능력치를 다시 평가하겠습니다.

정규 시즌 5, 11, 17주차와 플레이오프에 진행합니다.

시즌이 끝나면 스카우트가 선수별 신체 성장 보고서를 준비합니다.

column1:
<Week><from>NFL</from><subject>Franchise Tags</subject>

The offseason is the time when you will have the opportunity to place franchise tags on players. You can do this from the player information screen. 

Placing a franchise tag on a player will sign a player to an EXPENSIVE one year deal. Only use these tags on great players that have refused to re-sign with the team. Otherwise, you will be overpaying the players.
column2:
<Week><from>NFL</from><subject>프랜차이즈 태그</subject>

오프시즌에는 선수에게 프랜차이즈 태그를 걸 수 있습니다. 선수 정보 화면에서 할 수 있습니다.

프랜차이즈 태그를 걸면 그 선수와 아주 비싼 1년 계약을 맺게 됩니다. 재계약을 거부한 뛰어난 선수에게만 쓰세요. 그렇지 않으면 돈을 과하게 쓰게 됩니다.

column1:
<Week><from>PR Dept.</from><subject>Icons</subject>

Some players around the NFL reach an almost iconic status among their peers, coaches and fans. 

Once players reach "Icon" status, they have a huge impact on their team. 

Their presence affects fan support, attendance, free agents and many other aspects of franchise. 

Be careful, though. If an Icon is mistreated, it doesn't bode well for you.

Other players get upset, our prestige takes a hit and the fans don't appreciate it.
column2:
<Week><from>홍보팀</from><subject>아이콘</subject>

NFL에는 동료, 코치, 팬들 사이에서 거의 상징적인 존재가 되는 선수들이 있습니다.

"아이콘"의 위치에 오른 선수는 팀에 큰 영향을 미칩니다.

그들의 존재는 팬들의 지지, 관중 수, FA 영입 등 구단의 여러 면에 영향을 줍니다.

하지만 조심하세요. 아이콘 선수를 함부로 대하면 좋을 게 없습니다.

다른 선수들이 화를 내고, 명성이 떨어지며, 팬들도 좋아하지 않습니다.

column1:
<Week><from>PR Dept.</from><subject>Prestige</subject>

As you know, every team in the NFL has a certain prestige they've built up during their time in the league. 

Some teams routinely lose and make questionable decisions, while others are at the top of their game. 

Everything we do will affect our prestige, which in turn affects free agent decisions in the offseason. High prestige gives us an advantage over a poorly run team.
column2:
<Week><from>홍보팀</from><subject>명성</subject>

아시다시피 NFL의 모든 팀은 리그에서 쌓아 온 저마다의 명성이 있습니다.

늘 지고 이상한 결정을 하는 팀도 있고, 정상에 선 팀도 있죠.

우리가 하는 모든 일이 명성에 영향을 주고, 이는 오프시즌 FA 선수들의 결정에도 영향을 줍니다. 명성이 높으면 엉망으로 운영되는 팀보다 유리합니다.

column1:
<Week><from>PR Dept.</from><subject>Rivals</subject>

Rivalries are an integral part of the NFL. 

The Bears and Packers, Cowboys and Redskins and Chiefs and Raiders have hated each other for years. 

Rivalry games spark debate, trash talking and always make for intense contests. 

Beat your rival and you'll notice the benefits.
column2:
<Week><from>홍보팀</from><subject>라이벌</subject>

라이벌 관계는 NFL에서 빠질 수 없는 부분입니다.

베어스와 패커스, 카우보이스와 레드스킨스, 치프스와 레이더스는 오랫동안 서로를 미워해 왔습니다.

라이벌전은 논쟁과 신경전을 불러일으키고, 늘 치열한 승부가 됩니다.

라이벌을 이기면 그 효과를 느끼실 겁니다.

column1:
<Week><from>Paul Manias</from><subject>Draft Grades</subject>

After the draft every year, I will be grading each team's draft. 

How well you do in the draft will affect our team reputation, also.
column2:
<Week><from>폴 매니아스</from><subject>드래프트 평가</subject>

매년 드래프트가 끝나면 각 팀의 드래프트를 평가할 예정입니다.

드래프트를 얼마나 잘하느냐에 따라 팀 평판도 달라질 겁니다.

column1:
<Week><from>Personal Assistant</from><subject>Offseason</subject>

The offseason starts soon and we need to take care of some business before we start worrying about personnel.

Coaching decisions, stadium work and price changes should be first on the list.
column2:
<Week><from>개인 비서</from><subject>오프시즌</subject>

곧 오프시즌이 시작되니, 선수 문제를 고민하기 전에 처리할 일이 있습니다.

코치진 결정, 경기장 공사, 가격 조정을 가장 먼저 해야 합니다.

column1:
<Week><from>Personal Asst.</from><subject>Free Agency</subject>

Free Agency is the trickiest part of the offseason. 

Players will evaluate each team and make a decision based on a number of factors. 

Factors that the players take into account would be salary, team rep, stadium, Icons on your team, need for the player, coaches, talent on the team and even weather.
column2:
<Week><from>개인 비서</from><subject>FA 시장</subject>

FA 시장은 오프시즌에서 가장 까다로운 부분입니다.

선수들은 각 팀을 평가해서 여러 요소를 바탕으로 결정합니다.
